items.title: The failed or cancelled live action root cause and fix

attempts.what: Actions API audit of last 40 workflow runs
attempts.result: Identified exact failures: run 39933073507 (bot.yml) crashed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'resource' on windows-latest in engine/sentinel_engine/sandbox.py:18; safety dispatch step failed with IndentationError: unexpected indent in python inline script; bot/main.py missing acct=broker.account_info() before line 85.

attempts.what: Resume: authenticated Actions API audit of last 40 runs
attempts.result: HTTP 200. Latest bot run 39983309547 failed at c43649f. Training run 39929904179 is completed/failure, not currently running; preserve stored checkpoint and inspect before any resume.

Latest bot run 39983309547 logs: initialize attempt 3 returned False (last_err: (-10005, IPC timeout)); AssertionError: demo login failed. Previously fixed resource import and inline indentation were not the remaining root cause. Broker now passes credentials on its first initialize, allows 60 seconds, and uses the launched executable when available.

attempts.what: Pin native MT5 portable terminal path
attempts.result: Windows setup now launches a private writable portable terminal and exports the exact executable as MT5_TERMINAL_PATH. No password is written to the terminal configuration. Pending real Windows runner verification.

attempts.what: Bound acceptance runtime and pin authenticated account mode
attempts.result: BOT_CHAIN=false now ends after wall_seconds instead of running 5 hours. A demo runner cannot silently relabel itself real via Worker settings. Read-only login verification dispatched: https://github.com/vjumbo264/sentinel-fx/actions/runs/39985636231 .

attempts.what: Dispatch bounded demo bot acceptance run
attempts.result: Started demo-only bot run 39985787304 (wall_seconds=660, chain=false), https://github.com/vjumbo264/sentinel-fx/actions/runs/39985787304 . Run is pending; not marked passing. Read-only login run 39985636231 is installing MT5.

Two local startup regression tests PASS: first initialize supplies stored credentials, exact portable executable and 60000ms timeout; unknown account modes rejected. These are unit regressions only, not MT5 integration evidence.

attempts.what: Document original last-40 run evidence and exact failure lines
attempts.result: Fresh audit proves latest failure is native MT5 IPC timeout, not owner cancellation. Last green bot used Linux stack. Original training stopped at durable EURUSD v1 900000-step checkpoint due invalid volatility during evaluation. Exact lines and all 40 run URLs are in docs/FIX5_PROGRESS.md.

attempts.what: Restore owner-provided MT5 secret values with sealed encryption
attempts.result: GitHub repository secret writes all returned HTTP 204 (names only: MT5_PASSWORD, MT5_DEMO_LOGIN, MT5_DEMO_SERVER, MT5_REAL_LOGIN, MT5_REAL_SERVER). Values were encrypted outside the repository; no credentials committed or added to BUILD_STATE. Running Actions jobs retain their launch-time environment.

attempts.what: Restore last verified MT5 runtime after native IPC repair failed
attempts.result: Run 39985636231 still failed with IPC timeout on all three authenticated 60s initialization attempts, even with exact portable terminal path; login reporting separately returned HTTP 403. Rather than guessing further, bot.yml now uses the unchanged Linux stack from green run 39907951207 at 559d4762, preserving current READY handover, lease, concurrency and 4h backup cron.

attempts.what: Fix proven Cloudflare reporting User-Agent rejection
attempts.result: Native bot run 39985787304 failed with the same IPC timeout; no more speculative native retries. Separate real transport probe: default Python urllib UA gives HTTP 403 / error code 1010; sentinel-mt5-login/1.0 gives HTTP 200 for the same read-only authenticated endpoint. Added explicit User-Agent to login result reporting. Restored Linux demo run 39986703235 is starting.
